name: poppler-glib
input_api: g_file_get_contents(local path) to GBytes; poppler_document_new_from_bytes(GBytes*, ...); poppler_document_get_n_pages()
family: Poppler PDF parser, GLib C frontend
family_note: Poppler GLib C API shares core parser with the C++ Poppler frontend in the C++ PDF cell.

name: qpdf
input_api: qpdf_init(); qpdf_read(qpdf_data, local filename, password); qpdf_get_num_pages()
family: qpdf C API over C++ PDF parser
family_note: C translation unit linked with C++ linker, as official qpdf library documentation requires; shares qpdf engine with C++ PDF cell.

name: mupdf
family_note: Direct C API; same engine and release as C++ PDF call site.

name: ghostscript
input_api: gsapi_run_string using .PDFInit, local .PDFFile, .PDFInfo /NumPages; file-read permission granted for supplied path
family_note: Direct Ghostscript C API; same engine and release as C++ PDF call site.

name: pdfio
scope: PDF document page count and first page object
family_note: Direct C API built from pinned source; same engine and release as C++ PDF call site.

name: pdfium
input_api: FPDF_LoadDocument(local filename, NULL); FPDF_GetPageCount() and FPDF_LoadPage()
scope: PDF document page count and first page object
family_note: Direct C API. SHA-256-pinned distributor binary release and original header matched to canonical source revision; binary provenance remains limited to distributor release claim and header match. Same release and engine as C++ PDF cell.

name: vanillapdf
input_api: Document_Open(local filename); Document_GetCatalog(); Catalog_GetPages(); PageTree_GetPageCount() and PageTree_GetPage(1)
scope: PDF document page count and first page object
family: Vanilla.PDF C API over C++ PDF parser
family_note: Official publisher C ABI backed by its native C++ parser. C and C++ call sites share the same v2.3.0 engine and are one package path per ecosystem; the C++ call site uses the documented C API, not a separate C++ API.

name: tspdf
scope: PDF document page count and first parsed page
family_note: The same source library and parser engine is used by the C and C++17 adapters; counted once per ecosystem, not as separate syntax engines. Its zero-star GitHub metric is recorded without claiming broad adoption.

name: imagemagick
scope: Rendered PDF page sequence and first page dimensions
family: ImageMagick PDF coder + Ghostscript PDF interpreter
family_note: Distinct Magick package API; Ghostscript 10.08.0 performs underlying PDF interpretation in the recorded installation. The C and C++ APIs of this package share its core; its PDF syntax engine is shared with the separately counted Ghostscript path.

name: graphicsmagick
scope: Rendered PDF page sequence and first page dimensions
family: GraphicsMagick PDF coder + Ghostscript PDF interpreter
family_note: Distinct Magick package API; Ghostscript 10.08.0 performs underlying PDF interpretation in the recorded installation. The C and C++ APIs of this package share its core; its PDF syntax engine is shared with the separately counted Ghostscript path.

name: libvips
input_api: vips_pdfload(local filename, &VipsImage, NULL); vips_image_get_int("n-pages"); image width/height
scope: PDF page count and first page dimensions from PDF loader header
family: libvips vips-poppler module over Poppler PDF parser
family_note: The installed vips-poppler module links Poppler GLib 26.11.0; C and C++ libvips APIs share the same package and Poppler syntax engine. The adapter reads format-aware PDF metadata; libvips renders pixels lazily.

name: pdf_oxide
family: pdf_oxide Rust PDF parser via C ABI
family_note: The C ABI calls the Rust pdf_oxide engine. The C++ adapter uses the same source release and engine through its RAII header; paths in different ecosystems are not independent syntax engines.

name: libreofficekit
input_api: lok_init_2(pinned local app Frameworks, local profile URI); documentLoad(file:// local PDF path); getDocumentType(); getParts()
scope: PDF imported as a two-page Draw document through C LibreOfficeKit
family: LibreOffice PDF import through LibreOfficeKit C ABI
family_note: The installed package bundles xpdfimport with Poppler markers; the exact PDF import execution path was not traced. It is a distinct open-source package API but independence from Poppler/PDFium syntax engines is unestablished.

name: evince
scope: PDF page count through Evince libdocument C API
family: Evince PDF backend over Poppler GLib
family_note: Evince's public C libdocument factory loads the local PDF; the installed libpdfdocument backend directly links the Poppler GLib library already counted in this cell. This is a package path, not an independent PDF syntax engine.
